description: Read one webhook delivery in full: status, the signed event payload that was POSTed, and the per-attempt history (time, outcome, HTTP status, error). Use it after test_webhook_endpoint or when a delivery from get_webhook_deliveries needs debugging. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

deliveryId.description: The delivery ID (from get_webhook_deliveries or test_webhook_endpoint).
